description: Electricity Total Consumption by Zone Number is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset provides information about the total consumption of electricity in kilowatt-hours in the official zones of Qatar, for the years 2021 to 2026. The year 2026 covers January to August. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are Electricity Consumption. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
